market_view: Oil shock regime: WTI 93 (+8.5% in 5 days) with headlines of crude above $100 and US-Iran attacks continuing; the 10-year yield is at a one-year high (4.81%) and Fed hike talk weighs on stocks, while VIX stays low at 15.7.

oil_gas.catalyst: 'U.S. crude oil tops $100 again - as market braces for prolonged Iran war' (CNBC) and 'Trump says oil prices that spiked because of Iran war likely won't come down until after midterms' (AP News); XOM is -0.2% in 5 days while WTI is +8.5%, so the stock has lagged the supply shock.
oil_gas.reasoning: Continuing the XOM long from 2026-08-31 (exit about 2026-09-15). No exit trigger: no ceasefire, no Hormuz reopening, no windfall tax or SPR release, WTI 93 well above 83. Trump signalling tolerance of high prices lowers policy risk near term.

gold_miners.reasoning: Gold fell on the tanker strikes ('Gold prices drop following U.S. strikes on five Iranian oil tankers', Yahoo Finance); yields at a one-year high and Fed hike talk are headwinds. Analyst forecasts are not catalysts.

chips.reasoning: 'Regulators Are Investigating Nvidia's Licensing Deal With Groq' (NYT) is a negative overhang; CoreWeave demand comments restate known AI demand. No guidance or export-rule catalyst for NVDA.

pharma.reasoning: FDA camizestrant approval is AstraZeneca's, not LLY's; the earlier unnamed diabetes approval is still unconfirmed. LLY -8.8% in 20 days with no named cause; sector fell 2.5% yesterday.

copper_uranium.reasoning: Copper is at its 252-day high, but 'Metals Fall From Record High in London as Mideast Tensions Flare' (Bloomberg) and no supply outage is named; FCX's +5.4% day already priced the move. Uranium headlines are not one-sided.

would_change_my_mind: An Iran ceasefire, Hormuz reopening, SPR release or windfall tax (exit XOM); a named copper mine outage or an LLY-specific approval (consider a long).

handoff.what_changed: WTI rose to 93.0 (Brent 97.9) and headlines report crude above $100 as US and Iran launch new attacks; WSJ says Trump advisers see the war possibly lasting through end of term and Trump says oil prices won't fall until after the midterms. The 10-year yield is 4.81% with Fed hike talk (Warsh); regulators are investigating NVDA's Groq licensing deal; copper hit a 252-day high.

oil_gas.why: Prolonged Iran war keeps crude above 90 and no exit trigger has appeared; XOM has lagged crude.

gold_miners.why: Gold fell on the tanker strikes and yields are at a one-year high; no named catalyst.

chips.why: Regulatory probe of the NVDA-Groq deal is an overhang and there is no guidance or export-rule catalyst.

pharma.why: FDA approvals in the news are not LLY's; no LLY-specific catalyst.

copper_uranium.why: Copper at a high but no named supply shock; uranium news is not one-sided.
